rules.name: RANKED DUEL
rules.description: Shared deck. Raise, call, or fold.

fixedPolicy.description: Untuned heuristic: Hit soft <19, hard <17, except Stand hard 16 versus visible 2–6 unless trailing by 3+. Raise 19+ always, 18 at .65, 17 at .35, otherwise .08 (.15 trailing by 3+, zero when ahead and one point from target). Call 15+, soft hands or <=11; hard 12–14 Call .65 against 7+ upcard, .80 otherwise. Always Call if folding would end the match.

policies.description: Always Fold, including when that immediately loses the match.
Fold hard 12–14; Call all other hands.
Fold hard 12–13; Call all other hands.
Fold hard 12 only; Call all other hands.
Fold hard 12–16 only versus a visible 10-value card or Ace; otherwise Call.
Fold hard 12–16 only versus visible 2–6; otherwise Call.
Call if opponent is one point from target, self is one point from target, or trailing by 2+. Otherwise Fold hard 12–16 when leading by 2+, or hard 12 at other scores; Call everything else.

Call if Fold immediately loses or a called win can finish the match. Otherwise Fold hard 12–16 if losing the current two-point round ends the match while Folding keeps it alive; Call all other states.

Never Fold if that immediately loses. Fold hard 14–16 versus a visible 10/A only when leading by 2+, or when opponent is two points from target and self is not behind. Call all other states (including soft hands and hard 12–13).

counterfactual.sampling: First N seed pairs, both seats; one uniformly reservoir-sampled A response per eligible ALWAYS_CALL match. Subsequent responses ALWAYS_CALL; original SMART Hit/Stand and Raise retained. Sample eligibility varies by opponent; pooled CF is eligible-state-weighted, not equal-opponent-weighted.
